# pluralspace-oneshot-theme

An OneShot-inspired custom theme for pluralspace.app, used via its custom CSS
setting.

## Usage

Use the "Custom" theme option in Pluralspace and import with this code:
ps1.

CSS requires a userstyle extension like
[Stylus](https://github.com/openstyles/stylus) to inject custom CSS into a site.
Paste the contents of `pluralspace-oneshot-theme.css` into a new style for
pluralspace.app.

Assets live in `assets/` and are referenced from the CSS via
raw.githubusercontent.com URLs.

To change the wallpaper, modify the wallpaper variable at the top with one of
the example keys given
